name: Historical Concepts and Methods
description: This course aims to discuss select aspects of the nature of historian’s craft. The themes include the investigating the modernist character of the craft; the difference between study of the past in the modern and premodern era; the varying character of the historical consciousness across time and cultures; the influence of politics, ideology and patronage on the making of a historian’s perspective; history’s relationship with narratives and discourses; understanding the nature of a modern archive; and tracing the hidden, the ignored and the silenced narratives of the past.
